changes_made.explanation: Added 'Semantic Parsing' as a task since text2SQL is clearly an NLG task. Removed verbose output descriptions and consolidated to the main generated outputs. Kept Machine Translation and Code Generation as NLG tasks.
Normalized metric names - consolidated Sacre-BLEU to BLEU (since Sacre-BLEU is just an implementation of BLEU), and lowercase to title case. Removed duplicates.
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The paper only uses models for generation, not for evaluation.

guideline: We instruct the annotators to select the sentence that is more likely to occur in real user input settings (i.e., more plausible).

The human evaluation was for DATA QUALITY assessment (comparing real vs. synthetic noises), not for evaluating MODEL GENERATED OUTPUTS. overall_notes: The paper focuses on robustness testing of NLP models on noisy inputs, with evaluation on NLG tasks (MT, code generation, semantic parsing) using automatic metrics. Human evaluation was conducted for data collection quality assessment, not for evaluating model-generated outputs. The extraction incorrectly identified data quality evaluation as output evaluation.
